title: What Vestail provides
body: Vestail is operated by [LEGAL ENTITY NAME], [ADDRESS]. These terms cover our site, app and API. By using them you agree to these terms.

title: Eligibility information
body: Verdicts are eligible, conditional, restricted or unverified. They explain published ownership conditions. This is disclosure, not legal, tax or investment advice, a compliance guarantee or permission from a regulator. Get independent advice when needed.

title: Your declarations
body: Country, region and residency are self-declared. Vestail does not perform KYC. You must provide accurate information and follow the laws that apply to you.

title: Your wallet and transactions
body: Vestail is non-custodial. You approve and sign transactions with your own wallet. Vestail never holds your funds or private keys. Swaps and purchases route through third parties, including Jupiter and issuers; their fees, risks and terms apply.
